meta.description: Plot per-group distributions of continuous data using boxplots, violins, beeswarms, quasirandom jitter, and ggdist raincloud plots with sample-size honesty (Weissgerber 2015), KDE-bandwidth awareness, and N-aware encoding choices.
meta.audit_type: final-pass re-audit of the exact fixed commit
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.execution_note: Executed 7/7 exact-commit inputs with the data-visualization wrappers: R 4.4.3 / ggplot2 4.0.3 / ggdist 3.3.3 / introdataviz 0.0.0.9003, and Python 3.12 / seaborn 0.13.2 / matplotlib 3.11.2 / ptitprince 0.3.1. All inspected PNG/PDF outputs were nonempty. The process-local wrappers were sufficient; no cleanup profile was needed.

scientific_integrity.detail: The corrected nrd/nrd0 relation, bounded-data trim advice, N ranges, and cited visualization claims agree with the executed checks; no unsupported clinical claim is made.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is a research visualization Skill and does not diagnose, prescribe, or triage individuals.

methodological_ground.detail: The decision table preserves raw observations at small N, treats KDE as bandwidth-sensitive, and now rejects incomplete or low-N split-violin cells instead of giving a misleading density.

code_usability.detail: The shipped R and Python tests, standalone R example, current R blocks, split guards, and PDF export all executed on the documented current stack.

functional_suitability.note: The decision table, current ggdist raincloud, N annotations, current Python routes, and guarded split-violin workflow cover the stated task and ran.

reliability.note: Panel-wide SJ-to-nrd0 fallback, finite-value filtering, ordered two-level validation, and per-cell eligibility prevent the formerly silent failure modes; an empty eligible set is returned safely.

performance_context.note: The 194-line operational Skill is concise, with executable end-to-end material in the shipped example and a lean usage guide.

agent_usability.note: Version compatibility, a single N decision table, explicit failure remedies, deterministic jitter, and local-N labels provide actionable guidance; users must still choose a suitable encoding for their question.

human_usability.note: The trigger, prerequisites, prompt examples, colors, and N-aware choices are clear and scoped to distribution visualization.

security.note: No network, credential, shell, or destructive-data route is introduced; example output is a caller-local PDF.

maintainability.note: The standalone deterministic example and focused R/Python tests are shipped beside the instructions; reusable guards use explicit column arguments.

agent_specific.note: The description is specific, APIs and versions are named, archived gghalves is explicitly excluded, and the documented ptitprince compatibility limit is surfaced.

key_strengths: The exact current-stack R workflow replaces archived gghalves with ggdist and produced a standalone embedded-font PDF.
Tied and constant strata now select a panel-wide nrd0 fallback instead of silently blanking an SJ violin panel.
Ordered two-level validation and per-cell N filtering eliminate the missing-cell split-violin side swap seen in the archived audit.
The R and Python routes, deterministic examples, source tests, and current compatibility limits are explicit and executable.
